name: DataSync Pro
description: A third-party data integration vendor being evaluated for our enterprise data pipeline. DataSync Pro is a 3-year-old company offering ETL and data synchronization services. They would have read/write access to our customer database and internal analytics warehouse. They are SOC 2 Type I certified (not Type II). Their primary data centers are in the EU. They have experienced one minor data incident in the past 18 months involving a misconfigured S3 bucket. Their data processing agreement has not been reviewed by our legal team.
